items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical (Gift Card modules)
items.summary: An update to a critical vulnerability in Amasty's Gift Card modules, part of a larger security release for 25 extensions, allows arbitrary file upload locations leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for 25 Magento extensions, including one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento (versions before 4.0.0) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer (versions before 1.11.12) allows remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie and is actively being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-05
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin provides a critical security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, and execute unauthorized malicious code.}
